Subject: MAP & POC plan — NovaMed evaluation

Hi Ben / Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week — NovaMed's team is excited to move into a short POC to validate performance and safety for our clinical summarization workflow. Attached is a short checklist from our side that highlights the pieces procurement/legal will need (novamed-poc-checklist.pdf).

High-level asks we want to make sure are covered in the MAP:
- Success criteria: latency, throughput, hallucination rate, embedding retrieval quality, and cost per 1M tokens.
- Data handling: confirmation of encryption-at-rest, VPC/private deployment options, and any audit log capabilities (SOC2 evidence).
- Owners: who will own prompt sets, eval harness, and telemetry/cost reports from Redwood's side?
- Timeline: we'd like a 4-week execution window with a mid-POC sync after week 2.

Can you confirm Redwood owners for the items above and propose dates for the kickoff + mid-POC check-in? We can loop in our procurement contact after we have the MAP scoped.

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Dawson
Director, Clinical AI Programs
NovaMed Health

Claire — great summary and thanks for the checklist. Intro notes and proposed MAP outline below. Attaching our internal MAP checklist (redwood-map-checklist.xlsx).

Quick intros / owners from Redwood:
- Ben Carter (me) — account lead, overall timeline and procurement coordination.
- Marissa Cole — POC success lead (benchmarks, acceptance criteria, final sign-off).
- Karthik Iyer — evaluation engineer, owns prompt set curation and automated eval harness.
- Priyom Das — observability & cost telemetry owner, will deliver token-level cost reports.

Proposed MAP (4-week window):
1) Week 0 (this week) — MAP confirmation, legal/procurement kickoff, shared Drive + access, test dataset and prompt seeds delivered.
2) Week 1 — Integration & baseline runs (connect to private endpoint or hosted test env). Karthik runs baseline lat/throughput tests.
3) Week 2 — Prompt tuning & safety checks; mid-POC sync with NovaMed (30–45m). Deliver interim metrics.
4) Week 3 — Final benchmarks, cost analysis, and run the hallucination / factuality eval set.
5) Week 4 — Review results, decision meeting (pass/fail + next steps).

Meeting windows: we can do kickoff Wed 2027-01-13 at 10:00am PT or Thu 2027-01-14 at 9:00am PT — which works for you?

Action items for this thread:
- Ben: finalize MAP doc and calendar invite (redwood).
- Karthik: prepare prompt/eval harness template and a short demo of the harness.
- Priyom: draft telemetry report template showing P95 latency and cost breakdown per 100k tokens.

Thanks — we’ll aim to keep artifacts lightweight and shareable (CSV + Drive links).

Ben Carter

ben_carter@redwood.com

Ben / Claire — adding a concrete evaluation plan and measurable success criteria so we have something to sign off on at the kickoff.

Proposed success criteria (pass = all must be met unless otherwise noted):
- Latency: P95 generation latency <= 250ms for 512-token generative tasks on dedicated instance.
- Throughput: sustain 100 requests/sec at 8k context with tail latency under 400ms under continuous batching.
- Embedding retrieval: mean cosine similarity >= 0.92 for clinical snippet retrieval test set (N=500).
- Hallucination/factuality: hallucination rate <= 5% on the curated clinical reference set (we’ll provide ground truth).
- Cost: projected cost <= $XX per 1M tokens (we will finalize the target during week 1 once baseline runs complete).

Benchmark plan (owner in parentheses):
- Baseline latency/throughput (Karthik): scripted load test using our harness; report P50/P95/P99. (deliverable: baseline_metrics.csv)
- Prompt/eval set curation (Karthik + NovaMed): we will use 200 seed prompts (deliverable: prompts_seed.csv).
- Hallucination test (Marissa): 100-200 clinical QA pairs with gold answers (deliverable: hallucination_report.pdf).
- Cost telemetry (Priyom): token-level cost estimator + per-route breakdown (deliverable: cost_report.xlsx).

Owners and contact points:
- POC lead / roadmap: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.com)
- Eval harness & prompts: Karthik Iyer (karthik_iyer@redwood.com)
- Telemetry & cost: Priyom Das (priyom_das@redwood.com)
- Account & procurement: Ben Carter (ben_carter@redwood.com)

Deliverables & tentative dates:
- MAP doc + kickoff invite: by 2027-01-12 (Ben)
- Baseline metrics CSV: by 2027-01-21 (Karthik)
- Mid-POC sync notes: 2027-01-24 (team)
- Final report & decision meeting: 2027-02-07 (Marissa)

I’ll attach a minimal prompt/eval template (eval-prompt-owners.csv) that Karthik can use to onboard NovaMed prompts quickly. During kickoff we should run through the harness so NovaMed can see what pass/fail looks like.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
